The first amendment to the Indian Constitution was to “stifle public opposition”, and the 38th and 39th amendments should be studied by the youngsters to understand “what a power-hungry and anti-constitutional leadership can do”, Prime Minister Narendra Modi wrote in an op-ed on Constitution Day on Thursday.
In this video, Apoorva Mandhani explains what these amendments say and why they are so controversial.
